purpose: Preserve the ordinary Episode loop and controlled return boundary while adding pending dispatch, collection of already closed children, restored ownership contexts and a durable process execution binding. Application commissioning, completion replay and numerical waiting behavior require separate consumer integration.

details: EpisodeUpdate retains typed delivery failures and optional admitted report; views expose only admitted reports.
ChildEpisodeUnit catches explicitly typed ReportDeliveryError after independent credit projection, retaining child trace/result.
The shared Episode loop processes ReportRedelivery without controller advancement and updates the existing child edge with delivery history/revised contract.
Frame reconstruction is unchanged: opaque recorded payloads remain exactly compared; application journal tests reconstruct saved communication events.

Redelivery retains original child/result audit exclusions and final model-input checks; ordinary source adapters preserve administrative events. Single-unit experimental stepping cannot repair a prior trace it does not retain.

ChildEpisodeUnit.start_async commissions a child in an isolated Context stack with immutable parent/child goal ownership. Blocking and independent async returns use one projection/admission helper; no controller formula or completion observation is added at dispatch.
DeferredUnit returns PendingAction without advancing the controller or invoking the completed-unit hook.
ClosedChildUnit collects existing closed work through the original typed return boundary without rerunning a child source.
Context.from_commission restores the original parent goal/path boundary without a live parent stack.

An in-process parent waiting on one running child also wakes for any other owned child's completion. The temporary observer alone is cancelled; original child tasks, typed admission, zero-valued controller observations and exactly-once receipt identities are preserved. No elapsed-time or usage cutoff, new credit formula or replacement scheduler is introduced.
Export ReportDeliveryError and ReportRedelivery public composition types.
Export IndependentChild for explicit execution/collection composition.
Export PendingAction, DeferredUnit and ClosedChildUnit as public shared-loop ports.
Address each stored JSON value by its canonical content and byte-offset index hashes rather than a fresh UUID.
Repeated child closure, parent archival and resumed reconstruction reuse the same file addresses.
Serialization remains bounded in memory; existing atomic publication and ArchivedRecord integrity checks remain; no score, observation, communication form or continuation rule changes.

New in-process execution primitive: existing Episode.run_async and local controllers; parent-owned exactly-once collection; cancellation shielding; optional completed trace/result archival. Does not claim durable process execution or application commissioning integration.

Closing an owner releases its pending result-projection closures without cancelling children; successful receipt likewise releases no-longer-needed closures. Focused weak-reference tests cover both closed child and closed parent sources.
Persist immutable versioned commissions, single claimed process identities, typed returns, acknowledgments and exposed progress events.
Spawn detached workers and recover existing identities without automatic work retry; public status does not load child archives.
Race-free selected-event waiting uses durable cursors and Linux notifications, without a polling cadence or scientific scheduler.
Reconstruct exactly one selected child through the caller factory and run its ordinary Episode/controller.
Archive closure and preserve structured failed/interrupted outcomes and committed partial references; no report composer.
Retain interrupted outcome when the caller binding surfaces interrupted_execution with preserved partial records.
